note: Held-out tasks, agent alone (2 runs, gemini-3.5-flash-lite) vs FusionEdges port v3 (no AI). Judged from the browser screenshots each run saved and its diff. Not blind: the reviewer knew which approach made each run. A blind second review by a person is still to do.

scale.looks_like_donor: yes = the donor's navbar as designed; partly = donor's items/structure but not its look, or a visible defect; no = not the donor's navbar
scale.site_intact: yes = rest of the page as before; partly = moved/changed; no = part of the site lost or covered
